Controls (keyboard)

↑Throttle (hold; it ramps up)
↓Brake (hold; ramps to full pedal, can lock the wheels)
→ / ←GT350: shift up / down (automatic clutch).
BRM: shift up / down, 5-speed H (automatic clutch).
911: shift up / down, 6-speed H (automatic clutch, AWD).
Cadillac: selector N → D → S → L (Hydra-Matic shifts itself)
S or IIgnition: start / stop engine
1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5Select car (GT350 / Cadillac / BRM / Porsche 911 / Beetle), also the Car menu
VInside the car / Outside (rear); also the Position menu
EEngine bay (3D engine from the sound model’s parameters; drag to turn, pinch / wheel to zoom, double-tap to reset)
XNext sound model in this car's list (every model actually developed for this car, in chronological order)
BBRM: next engine sound in the BRM list (v12 · BRM p1–p4, p6, p8–p11, default p11; formerly v9.1–v9.11). There is no shipped p5 or p7. The older v8 model has been retired
ZInk / Flat visuals (also the Visuals menu)
Ukm/h ↔ mph
A / DSteer left / right (touch: drag sideways on the road)
QDrag strip (1/4 mile) on / off
CRoad course (prototype), on / off: Mesa Run, 6.2 km over the hills, 4 checkpoints and the finish against a countdown (each checkpoint adds time), three rivals, traffic and things to hit. A / D steer (touch: the steering pad). ?course=mesa: the old flat lap
RRadio (Cadillac)
TReset trip meter
MMute
HAbout / History, including how the sound model works
Engine specifications (Specs button, or the link under Car)

Touch / mouse

Brake pedal left, gas right: press higher up the pedal for more. Shift buttons next to the gas. Works with several fingers at once, and with a mouse. Steer by dragging sideways on the road.

Car

Engine sound is synthesised live in the browser (no recordings). The inside sound is a model (exhaust through the body, intake and mechanical noise through the firewall, cabin boom, road and wind noise), not a measured cabin.
